POLICIES

1) Contractual leave and leave salary can be availed only after completion of Contract subject to the approval of Management.
2) Contractual leave will be approved on the basis of working days (but Includes in-between weekend & public holidays as per Company policy).
3) Employees are not permitted to avail salary advance or personal loans from the Company while going on any leave.
4) Company Vehicle, Laptop, office keys, tools/equipment of Company to be handed over to the concerned department before going on Leave.
5) Employee to handover their passport to the Admin Department after rejoining (Not applicable for Qatari Employees).
6) In case of unauthorized extension of leave, penalty will be levied on personnel as per company policies; also performance allowance will not be paid. Paid for next month's salary, upon re-joining in such cases.
